summary: Both retirements REJECTED as recorded. The verdicts' cited rows are totals and the conclusion that no per-position percent of net assets is filed holds on the page and in the XBRL (current-period position contexts are nil; the only valued identifier-axis facts are a mis-tagged BOCSO footnote), and published FV ties exactly. But each entry's recorded evidence states a false fact count, and the rerun check that is supposed to reproduce it is blind: its regex only matches single-line facts with contextRef as the first attribute (it sees 0 of 1,179 facts in -000011 and 23 of 159 in -000027) and its member filter only reads explicit *Member names, so it cannot see this filer's typed InvestmentIdentifierAxis position contexts at all. A retirement whose rerun would pass even if positions carried percents is not a deterministic check under D-252. Re-issuable once the check parses facts with an XML parser, tests typed identifier-axis contexts, and the evidence quotes are corrected (corrected figures below).

retirement_reviews.rationale: Verdict file sha256 matches the entry (2b0ea426...). Rerun of boz_retirements.py nbocf prints PASS, but its evidence line '0 valued InvestmentOwnedPercentOfNetAssets facts' is false: an XML parse of 000181255426000011.xml finds 1,179 facts, 544 nil (all 2025-12-31; 542 on InvestmentIdentifierAxis position contexts) and 635 valued (77 at 2025-12-31, 558 at 2024-12-31 of which 498 sit on InvestmentIdentifierAxis position contexts of the comparative schedule). The check reads 0 because every fact in this file is written across several lines. Substance checked independently and it holds: (1) both cited rows are totals and equal the filed values (rating table 'Total $ 35,918,948 100.0 %' is percent of fair value, not of net assets; SOI 'Total Investments $ 35,983,158 $ 35,918,948 181.8 %'); (2) the 77 valued current-period facts are industry, issuer-affiliation, investment-type and total contexts, plus 4 typed InvestmentIdentifierAxis facts (Blue Owl Cross-Strategy Opportunities LLC 0.62; ABF - Specialty finance 0.62, ABF - Leasing 0.33, BF - Commercial Real Estate 0.05) that tag the BOCSO footnote ('largest investment is 62.0% of the total cost of BOCSO's portfolio ... 62% / 33.0% / 5.0%'), not position percents of net assets; position contexts at 2025-12-31 are nil; (3) the page prints a '% of Net Assets' value only on industry subtotals and totals, position lines end at fair value; (4) published-basis 2025-12-31 rows 882 in both nbocf and data/output, 0 with pct_of_net_assets, sum FV 35,918,948,000 = printed. Rejected because the recorded evidence misstates the filing and the rerun check cannot detect the condition it certifies (it would also pass if positions carried valued percents in multi-line facts or on typed members). Fix: replace criterion 3 with an XML-parser test that no valued current-period fact sits on an InvestmentIdentifierAxis context other than the BOCSO footnote members (or that the BOCSO four are explicitly recognised), correct the evidence quote to the figures above, then re-issue.
